label: Concurrent actualization in every respect from its esse instance (inference)
rule: Lackable act to lackable being; esse instance; accident-inclusive conservation
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let x be in act in r and able to lack that act. By the lackable-being bridge x is in act as to being and could lack being; by the esse instance something g other than x presently gives x being; by accident-inclusive conservation g presently actualizes x in r. Without accident-inclusive conservation the esse instance does not give C* in the holding sense (Control part 2). All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
